'''Serpent's Coil''' is a winding cave system that had been occupied by evil cultists worshipping [[Kirith the Damned]]. It is located in the eastern area of the [[Blasted Lands]], in sight of [[Nethergarde Keep]]. Several burnt-out [[orcish]] structures stand here, remnants from the [[Second War]]. [[Archmage Allistarj]] operates his [[Shadowsworn]] forces from within this small labyrinth.
